info.name: YoSmart / YoLink API V2 - Complete Collection
info.description:
# YoSmart Open API V2 - Complete Postman Collection

Comprehensive collection covering **all** YoSmart API V2 endpoints.

## Authentication
- Uses OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials flow (UAC)
- Access tokens expire in 3600 seconds (1 hour)
- Refresh tokens before expiration

## API Architecture
- **NOT RESTful** — uses JSON-RPC style with a single POST endpoint
- All device API calls go to the same endpoint, differentiated by `method` field
- Data packets: BDDP (request) / BUDP (response)

## Setup Instructions
1. Set `uaid` and `secret_key` in the **Environment Variables**
2. Run **"Get Access Token"** request first — it auto-saves the token
3. All subsequent requests use the saved `access_token` automatically

## Environments
Import the included environment and fill in your UAC credentials.

## Rate Limits
- MQTT: Max 5 concurrent connections, 10 new connections per 5 minutes
- HTTP: Follow exponential backoff on 010301 errors

---
**Documentation**: https://doc.yosmart.com/docs/overall/intro
**Support**: service@yosmart.com | yaochi@yosmart.com

item.name: 🔐 Authentication
item.description: OAuth 2.0 token management — get, refresh, and validate access tokens.

exec: console.log('✅ Access token saved. Expires in ' + json.expires_in + ' seconds.');

request.description:
Obtain an access token using UAC client credentials.

**Response Fields:**
- `access_token` — JWT bearer token (valid ~1 hour)
- `refresh_token` — Use to get new access_token without re-authenticating
- `expires_in` — Token lifetime in seconds
- `token_type` — Always "Bearer"

⚠️ **Run this first** before any other request.

urlencoded.description: Refresh token from previous auth response

request.description:
Refresh an expired access token using the refresh_token.

**Best Practice:** Call this before the access_token expires (check `expires_in`).

The collection's pre-request script handles this automatically.

item.name: 🏠 Home
item.description: Home-level operations — device listing, home info. These are UAC-compatible methods.

exec: console.log('✅ Saved first device: ' + firstDevice.name + ' (' + firstDevice.type + ')');

request.description:
Get the complete list of devices associated with your UAC account.

**Response per device:**
- `deviceId` — Unique device identifier
- `deviceUDID` — Device unique ID
- `name` — User-friendly name
- `token` — Net token (required for device control)
- `type` — Device type (e.g., Hub, THSensor, DoorSensor)
- `modelName` — Model number
- `parentDeviceId` — Parent device (if applicable)

🔄 First device is auto-saved to environment variables.

Get general info about the home, including the **Home ID**.

The Home ID is required for MQTT topic subscriptions:
- `yl-home/${Home ID}/+/report` — Device events
- `yl-home/${Home ID}/**/request` — Send requests
- `yl-home/${Home ID}/+/response` — Receive responses

🔄 Home ID is auto-saved to environment.

item.name: 📡 Hub

request.description:
Get the current state of a YoLink Hub.

**Response:**
- `data.version` — Hub firmware version
- `data.wifi.enable` — WiFi connected
- `data.wifi.ssid` — Connected WiFi network

**Parameters:**

item.name: 🌡️ THSensor (Temperature & Humidity)
item.description: Temperature & Humidity Sensor operations — state, logs, and metrics.

request.description:
Get the current state of a Temperature & Humidity sensor.

**Response:**
- `data.online` — Device online status
- `data.state.temperature` — Current temperature (°C)
- `data.state.humidity` — Current humidity (%)
- `data.state.battery` — Battery level (0-4)
- `data.state.state` — State ["normal", "alert"]
- `data.state.alarm` — Alarm states (lowBattery, lowTemp, highTemp, lowHumidity, highHumidity)
- `data.state.tempLimit` — Temperature alert range (min/max)
- `data.state.humidityLimit` — Humidity alert range (min/max)
- `data.state.tempCorrection` — Temperature calibration offset
- `data.state.humidityCorrection` — Humidity calibration offset

Retrieve activity logs for a TH Sensor within a date range.

⚠️ Requires `DEVICE.HISTORICAL_DATA.READ` permission.

**Params:**
- `search.startDate` — Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `search.endDate` — End date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `retrievalKey` — Pagination key for next page

**Response:**
- `data.logs[].id` — Record ID
- `data.logs[].time` — Timestamp
- `data.logs[].data` — Record data
- `data.retrievalKeys.next` — Key for next page
Retrieve next page of activity logs using a retrieval key from previous response.

Retrieve metrics logs (temperature/humidity data points) for charting.

⚠️ Requires `DEVICE.HISTORICAL_DATA.READ` permission.

**Response:**
- `data.logs[].time` — Timestamp
- `data.logs[].*` — Metric values

item.name: 🔌 Outlet
item.description: Smart outlet/plug operations — state, control, scheduling, and firmware.

request.description:
Get the current state of an Outlet.

**Response:**
- `data.state` — ["closed", "open"]
- `data.delay.on` — Delay ON remaining (minutes)
- `data.delay.off` — Delay OFF remaining (minutes)
- `data.power` — Current power consumption (watts)
- `data.version` — Firmware version

Turn an outlet ON.

**Parameters:**
- `state` — ["open", "close"]
Turn an outlet OFF.

Set delay ON/OFF for an outlet.

**Parameters:**
- `delayOn` — Minutes until ON (0 = cancel)
- `delayOff` — Minutes until OFF (0 = cancel)

Get the schedule list for an outlet.

**Response per schedule:**
- `isValid` — Enabled/disabled
- `index` — Schedule index (0-5)
- `on` — Turn on time (HH:mm)
- `off` — Turn off time (HH:mm)
- `week` — Bitmask of active days (Sun-Sat)

Set schedules for an outlet (max 6 schedules, index 0-5).

**Week bitmask:** 127 = all days (1111111 binary, Sun-Sat)

Get firmware info for an outlet.

**Response:**
- `data.version` — Current firmware version
- `data.newVersion.versionId` — Latest version ID
- `data.newVersion.versionCode` — Latest version code
- `data.newVersion.fileSize` — Update file size

Start a firmware upgrade on an outlet.

⚠️ Get the `versionId` from `Outlet.getVersion` first.

Get activity logs for an outlet.

⚠️ Requires `DEVICE.HISTORICAL_DATA.READ` permission.

item.name: 🌡️ Thermostat
item.description: Thermostat operations — state, control, schedules, ECO, properties, correction, and firmware.

request.description:
Get the full state of a thermostat.

**Response includes:**
- `state.temperature/humidity` — Current readings
- `state.mode` — ["cool", "heat", "auto", "off"]
- `state.fan` — ["on", "auto"]
- `state.sche` — ["run", "hold"]
- `state.running` — ["cool", "heat", "idle"]
- `state.lowTemp/highTemp` — Set points
- `properties.*` — Runtime limits, AUX settings
- `eco.*` — ECO configuration

Set thermostat state.

**Parameters (all optional):**
- `mode` — ["cool", "heat", "auto", "off"]
- `fan` — ["on", "auto"]
- `lowTemp` — Lower set point (°C)
- `highTemp` — Upper set point (°C)
- `sche` — ["run", "hold"]

Get thermostat schedules.

**Response:** 7 weekdays × 4 time points each with time, lowTemp, highTemp.

Set thermostat schedules.

**Structure:** Array of weekdays (Mon-Sat), each with 4 continuous time points.

Set timezone for thermostat (required for schedules).

**Parameters:** `tz` — Timezone offset (-12 to +12)

Set ECO mode for thermostat.

**Parameters:**
- `mode` — ["on", "off"]
- `lowTemp` — Lower adjustment (0-5°C)
- `highTemp` — Upper adjustment (0-5°C)

Set thermostat runtime properties.

**Parameters (all optional):**
- `minRuntime` — Min cooling/heating runtime
- `coolLimit` — Min cooling temp (°C)
- `heatLimit` — Max heating temp (°C)
- `mute` — Mute device
- `menuLock` — Lock menu
- `auxStandby/auxMaxSpan/auxThreshold` — AUX heater settings
- `stage2Standby/stage2MaxSpan/stage2Threshold` — 2nd stage settings
- `master` — Temp source ["local", "sensor1", "sensor2"]

Set temperature and humidity correction for the local sensor.

**Parameters:**
- `temperature` — Correction value (+/- 5.0°C)
- `humidity` — Correction value (+/- 10%)
Get firmware info for a thermostat.
Start firmware upgrade on a thermostat.

Get activity logs for a thermostat.

⚠️ Requires `DEVICE.HISTORICAL_DATA.READ` permission.

Toggle the garage door open/closed.

⚠️ **Caution:** Check the state of the Garage Door Sensor first before calling this!

Use `DoorSensor.getState` with the paired sensor to verify current position.

item.name: 🏭 Device Production
item.description:
Manufacturing & provisioning API for device production.

⚠️ CSID with `production/*` scope required.

**Endpoint:** `https://api.yosmart.com/open/production/v2/api`

request.description:
Request a batch of device IDs for manufacturing.

⚠️ Ensure you have sufficient Device Licenses.

**Parameters:** `size` — Number of IDs to request

**Response:** `data.deviceIdList` — Array of device IDs

Activate a Device ID by associating it with a physical device.

**Parameters:**
- `deviceId` — Target device ID (optional; auto-allocated if omitted)
- `chipId` — Unique chip identifier (required)
- `appEui` — Application EUI (required)

Activate a device with auto-allocated Device ID.

Omit `deviceId` to let the system assign one automatically.

Request a batch of serial number codes.

**Parameters:** `size` — Number of SN codes to generate

**Response:** `data.snList` — Array of SN codes

Bind a serial number to an activated device.

⚠️ Device must be activated first (see Activate Device ID).

**Parameters:**
- `deviceId` — Activated device ID (required)
- `sn` — SN code (optional; auto-generated if empty)
Bind an auto-generated SN to an activated device.
